# AutoMedia

> Automated media production pipeline for content teams and AI coding agents.

AutoMedia automates content production from topic selection through draft
writing, video generation, subtitle rendering, and multi-platform publishing.

## Agent entry points
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): agent-role codebase context, constraints, red lines, MCP/CLI references
- [README.md](README.md): project entry point — install, quick start, architecture, testing
- [docs/index.md](docs/index.md): documentation home

## Validation
- [scenarios/STANDARDS.md](scenarios/STANDARDS.md): the single schema authority for validation `standard:` keys
- [scenarios/README.md](scenarios/README.md): agent-tester validation framework onboarding
- [docs/dev/agent-reference.md](docs/dev/agent-reference.md): validation layer contract, directory layout, task patterns

- [docs/dev/developer-guide.md](docs/dev/developer-guide.md): full developer guide
